# Vendored tldr-pages

Example commands from [tldr-pages](https://github.com/tldr-pages/tldr), used by `pnpm deck:generate` to rank options into tiers and to attach examples (which also feed cloze cards).

- Pinned commit: see `pin.json`. Refresh with `pnpm tldr:vendor`; add a page by adding its name to `pin.json` first.
- License: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), © the tldr-pages contributors. Decks that use these examples say so in their `attribution`.
